name: Cured In Place Pipe
tagline: Your top source for Cured In Place Pipe Contractors.

form.defaultAccessKeyNote: Web3Forms access key for the site-wide (Joe-only) form. Create a form named 'CuredInPlacePipe.net' in https://app.web3forms.com (recipient organicseopositions@gmail.com) and paste its access key here. Per-contractor keys go in contractors.json -> web3formsKey. While this is empty the forms render but post nowhere, so fill it before cutover.
form.turnstileNote: Cloudflare Turnstile site key (Cloudflare dashboard -> Turnstile -> Add widget, hostnames curedinplacepipe.net + curedinplacepipe.pages.dev, Managed mode). Leave empty to disable the widget; the honeypot field still runs.
